notes: Elvish Reclaimer (M20). Printed: '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a land' pays with a land seat 0 CONTROLS (CR 701.21a), whoever owns it. Seat 0 controls its own Test Land One and a land owned by the opponent (Stolen Land, control changed to seat 0), and the opponent controls a land owned by seat 0 (Lent Land): the sacrifice ask offers exactly the two lands seat 0 controls (card:1, card:2), not the lent one (card:3).
